items.title: Rogers Communications (TSX:RCI.B) Moved, So What Is Drawing Attention Now?
items.summary: Rogers Communications (TSX:RCI.B) just paired a new Apple hardware lineup with its premium 5G+ plans, while also raising long dated subordinated debt and refinancing older notes. That mix puts both consumer offerings and capital structure in focus. Despite the fresh Apple lineup and debt issuance news, Rogers Communications’ recent share price momentum has been soft, with the stock down 4.9% over the past 90 days and 4.2% year to date.
